Cultural Spotlight · Region 1 of 10

Europe

Field Footage

An overview of Europe as a cultural region

Field Notes

Europe is a diverse cultural region that has played a major role in shaping world history. The region is home to many languages, ethnic groups, and national identities, yet countries share important cultural connections. Christianity has historically been a major influence on European culture, architecture, and traditions. Europe was the birthplace of the Renaissance, Scientific Revolution, and Industrial Revolution, all of which transformed the world. Today, much of the region enjoys a high standard of living and advanced economies. The European Union has increased cooperation among many countries through trade, travel, and shared policies. Despite its diversity, Europe remains connected by a common historical and cultural heritage.
